messages:
amanda: FYI: ACME retest window booked Wed 10:00-12:00 UTC. Need final signoff on RBAC changes, KMS artefact proofs, and audit-log export plan. who can own the access window and evidence handoff?

raj: I can own RBAC + ephemeral role provisioning. pls confirm exact resources (k8s namespaces, bucket paths, kms alias).

amanda: Scope: k8s ns inference-prod, s3://redwood-pt-evidence/acme-retest-2026, kms alias/ci/model-key.

lina: oncall-sre here 52 Ill run CloudTrail + k8s audit snapshots and upload shas. plan to compress outputs and put hashes in manifests.

oliver: can we standardize a small manifest per resource: {"type","start","end","sha256","command","key_id","cloudtrail_run"}? assessors love consistent files.

amanda: yes. manifests live under s3://redwood-pt-evidence/acme-retest-2026/manifests/ with names like resource-20260325T100000Z.json. include network_restrictions and extension_procedure fields.

raj: ephemeral role proposal: 1hr TTL, approver buffer 2hr. example to share with assessors:

```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-ephemeral-inference --role-session-name acme-retest --duration-seconds 3600
```

we'll restrict to GET/PutObject on evidence prefix and k8s view for inference-prod. no kms:Create* or Admin perms.

oncall-sre: add runbook: "request extension via infra/pt-requests PR; auto-grant if both approvers (raj,lina) approve within 15m". avoids manual ticketing.

lina: audit export commands I'll run (example):

```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --start-time 2026-03-25T10:00:00Z --end-time 2026-03-25T12:00:00Z --query Events > cloudtrail.json
gzip cloudtrail.json && sha256sum cloudtrail.json.gz > cloudtrail.sha256
kubectl --context prod --namespace inference-prod get events --all-namespaces -o json > k8s-audit.json
gzip k8s-audit.json && sha256sum k8s-audit.json.gz > k8s-audit.sha256
aws s3 cp cloudtrail.json.gz s3://redwood-pt-evidence/acme-retest-2026/logs/
aws s3 cp k8s-audit.json.gz s3://redwood-pt-evidence/acme-retest-2026/logs/
```

I'll include the commands verbatim in the manifest so assessors can reproduce.

oliver: KMS: provide key policy snapshot, DescribeKey output, and rotation status + last-rotation timestamp. put under s3://redwood-pt-evidence/acme-retest-2026/kms/. include key-id in manifest.

amanda: also state whether key is customer-managed vs. platform-managed. both proofs required.

raj: iam PR will include role policy with network condition limiting to corp and pre-shared assessor IPs. will mark as draft until manifests exist.

amanda: triage owner: put a single triage lead for inference-prod in the manifest. oliver?

oliver: i'll be triage lead. i'll add a tiny triage sheet at security/triage/acme-retest.md and link it from manifest.

lina: smoke tests for retest verification: run inference healthcheck and capture pod logs. include small run-id and sha in manifest.

security-bot: created SEC-PT-4521 (ACME retest 52) assigned raj,lina,amanda https://jira.redwood.internal/browse/SEC-PT-4521

amanda: action list: raj = RBAC PR + role policy; lina = audit export + smoke logs; oliver = triage sheet + manifest links; oncall-sre = monitor and approve extensions; i will assemble final manifest and close ticket. ping this thread when uploads complete. :thumbsup:

lina: uploads scheduled Tue 18:00 UTC; i'll post s3 links here once done.

raj: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/834 (ephemeral role). marking draft.

amanda: please ensure manifests include exact commands, timestamps, sha256s, and the k8s/cloudtrail run ids. i'll review Wed 08:00 UTC. thanks all.

security-bot: reminder: evidence retention requires artifacts to be kept 90 days. extend via SEC-PT-4521-EXT if assessors request longer.
